Preserve the real dull bronze threshold with its necessary local BLUE sheen and the original unlit RIGHT gap; no new glowing shapes. All physical contacts and current source branch conditions stay intact.

This is replacement of environmental surface mark-making in the specified regions, NOT blur, sharpening, a dark filter or a whole-frame reconstruction. The broad new opaque paint planes must be clearly simpler than the source surfaces at reader scale, with the unchanged people/props reading first. Keep serious restrained folklore graphic-novel ink and matte washes, not photography.
